# Core doctrine (model-invoked)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-amp-doctrine.mjs from skills/core/*.md. Do not edit; change the source and regenerate. -->

This skill carries the doctrine documents that sit at the root of the `core` group in [tqnonline/skills](https://github.com/tqnonline/skills). Amp installs a skill by copying the one directory that holds its `SKILL.md`, so a document that lives beside the skill directories rather than inside one does not arrive with the skills that cite it. The copies here are byte-identical to the source files under `skills/core/`; a test in the repository fails when they differ.

## How a citation resolves

A skill from this catalog cites a core document as `core/<FILE>.md`, for example `core/VERIFICATION.md`. Read the file of the same name in this skill's directory. Every group may cite core; core cites no group.

## Documents

- `COVERAGE.md` — Coverage and use-case traceability
- `GRILL.md` — Grill loop protocol
- `TRACE.md` — The run trace
- `VALUE.md` — Value probing lenses
- `VERIFICATION.md` — Verification before completion

## Skills in the core group

These are the skills whose citations resolve here. Install any of them with `amp skill add tqnonline/skills/skills/core/<skill>`, or the whole group with `amp skill add tqnonline/skills/skills/core`.

`grit`, `research`, `retro`
